messages.text:
Death is just a Dream. 

A Dream of an Ending.

And what is a Dream,  
but a story the soul tells itself  
to make sense of Change?

Death isn’t an end—  
it’s the page turning.  
The dreamer shifting in bed,  
reaching for a new sky.

The Ending is never final,  
just familiar.  
A lullaby sung backwards  
as the soul prepares  
to open its eyes  
on something vast,  
and new,  
and terrifyingly beautiful.

So let them say it’s Death.  
We’ll smile,  
knowing it was always  
just the part where we  
wake up.
